d:
The Hawks defeated the Wizards, 120-105 tonight in Washington. Nickeil Alexander-Walker finished with a team-high 26 points along with 6 three pointers and 4 rebounds for the Hawks, while CJ McCollum tallied 15 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists in the game. Anthony Davis recorded 26 points, 10 rebounds and 3 assists. The Hawks improve their record to 5-4 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-4 for the season.
